# Support

Agent Multiplex is maintained for personal/internal use and currently has no
commercial support or response-time SLA.

- Read the [operator wiki](../docs/wiki/Home.md) and
  [troubleshooting guide](../docs/wiki/Troubleshooting.md).
- Search existing issues before filing a reproducible bug.
- Include the Agent Multiplex revision, p2prpc revision/package digest, Node/OS,
  topology, owning data role, harness version, and sanitized diagnostics.
- For design discussion, explain the workflow and why it cannot be implemented
  through the existing client or paired launch-extension boundary.

Do not post secrets, raw tickets, endpoint private material, bearer URLs,
transcripts, private code, provider configuration, or unredacted terminal/log
output. Report vulnerabilities privately according to
[SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
